about: The band's sound words (Jonathan, 28 Oct and 1 Nov 2026: darker, murkier, muddled, gravel; never bright, fresh, friendly or a marching band). take_factory.variant() reads this file for every take. To change the band's sound, edit this file, or point to another file with a line 'sound-words-file: <path>' in hub/tower/band-2026-10-28/sound-direction-2026-10-28.md. No artist is named here. 6 Nov 9:15 AM, Jonathan: no cheesy traditional background jazz; the jam direction is jazz reinvented with a grunge undertone (plain jazz stays allowed).
always: dark and murky, low-mid heavy, rolled-off highs, tape hiss, smeared reverb, loose timing dragging behind the beat, rough and alive
